# Fixtures

The golden vectors for the wire formats. They are generated by the firmware repository (`MeshCore-beacon-client`), which
owns the formats, and must not be edited by hand.

| File | Format | Source test | Firmware commit |
|---|---|---|---|
| `beacon_report_v1.json` | observation reports, `data_type` 0xFFBE | `test/test_beacon_report/test_beacon_report.cpp`, env `BEACON_REPORT_VECTORS_OUT` | `55fe473a` |
| `beacon_names_v1.json` | name announcements, `data_type` 0xFFBF | `test/test_beacon_names/test_beacon_names.cpp`, env `BEACON_NAMES_VECTORS_OUT` | `28bb4985` |

Both commits are on the firmware repository's `beacon` branch.

- Regenerate by running the test with the environment variable set to `<path>/<file>.json`, then copy the file here and
  update the commit above. When a format's `version` byte changes, add a new fixture file for the new version and keep the
  old one while the old version is still decoded.
- `tests/test_wire.py` checks `src/beacon_base/wire.py` against both.
